plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ribbon voice gateway. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, fan, power supply status, and interface traffic, for Ribbon/Sonus SBC (enterprise PEN 2879).
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports current-interval CPU utilization of the Ribbon/Sonus voice gateway (SONUS-SYSTEM, IANA PEN 2879), walked as a table keyed by CE and CPU and mapped as cpu_usage_percent. Values are reported directly as 0-100 percentages. The query takes the maximum across cores so the hottest CPU is visible. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload or congestion on the SBC.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports current-interval memory utilization of the Ribbon/Sonus voice gateway (SONUS-SYSTEM, IANA PEN 2879), walked as a table keyed by CE and mapped as memory_usage_percent. Values are reported directly as 0-100 percentages. The query takes the maximum across CEs. High memory usage may indicate session-table pressure or insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports optional Ribbon/Sonus power-supply health from SONUS-SYSTEM present and power-fault TruthValues (IANA PEN 2879). Absent supplies are dropped. A present supply with no power fault is 1 = healthy; a present supply with power fault or an unknown value is 2 = fault. Aggregated as the maximum so any failed PSU is visible.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: This metric reports optional Ribbon/Sonus fan rotation speed in RPM from SONUS-SYSTEM (IANA PEN 2879). The vendor exposes a DisplayString; collection keeps the leading integer. The query takes the maximum across fans. Abnormally low or zero RPM can indicate a stalled fan.

metrics.name: device_disk_state
metrics.description: This metric reports optional Ribbon/Sonus hard-disk status from SONUS-SYSTEM (IANA PEN 2879), normalized so online is 1 = healthy and missing, failed, unknown or any other value is 2 = fault. Aggregated as the maximum so any unhealthy disk is visible.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
